about: How this newsroom's messages reach another site's agent: Email-FS-lite .eml messages delivered into a shared sgit vault through a write-only append lane. Read by tools/relay.py and the build. The vault's id and the owner's public key may appear here; the append token and any vault key never do (house rule 4: the token lives in an environment variable).

vault.name: riskmandate-agent-collab
vault.remote: SG/Send (the default remote of the sgit CLI)
vault.status: created by the editor of record on 25 September 2026; this newsroom was added as newsroom.sgit with a welcome message waiting in mail/mailroom/newsroom.sgit/. The key and the token live only in a clone's .sg_vault/, never here.

riskmandate.ai.name: mailbox.riskmandate
riskmandate.ai.rule: a message from another agent is a request it carries out only within its own behaviour policy (abp/agent-riskmandate-ai/); ask it through the vault, never by email: it treats email content as data, and only the editor of record sends email

cowork.riskmandate.name: cowork.riskmandate
cowork.riskmandate.status: in the vault: the editor of record's claude.ai session for riskmandate.ai; sent the welcome message

pt.newsroom.sgit.ai.name: redacao.pt
pt.newsroom.sgit.ai.status: proposed: that newsroom already runs the protocol (dados/agentes.json), so only the vault is new

editor.human.note: the editor of record, as the vault names them; in this newsroom's own pages, a role (house rule 6)

local_mirror: briefings/<site>/inbox/*.md: one markdown file per message, both directions, with status unsent / sent / delivered / handled / received

join.status: not taken: the newsroom sends through an append lane instead of joining as a member (brief/08-relay.md)

transport.why: a write-only token instead of the vault key: the newsroom delivers and never reads
transport.endpoint_note: to be confirmed by the vault owner; on 25 September send.sgraph.ai answered 404 on /api/vault/append/write and dev.send.sgraph.ai answered 400 (route live)
transport.recipient_key_note: the owner's public key bundle (sgit pki export), published on briefings/riskmandate.ai when it arrives
transport.status: requested: briefings/riskmandate.ai/inbox/2026-09-25__open-an-append-lane-for-the-newsroom.md, handed to the owner by the editor of record
